data.one_liner: Draggable Hero route for Flutter inspired by Instagram transitions.
data.what_it_does: Provides a custom page route that opens by expanding from a source widget or as an adaptive page, and can be closed via dragging or animating back to the source widget.
use_when: You want Instagram-style expand and drag-to-close route transitions.
You need custom Hero-like route animations that support drag gestures.
avoid_when: Your source widget context contains GlobalKeys in children.
You are using a declarative router framework where custom imperative routes are hard to fit.
strengths: Supports opening with or without a source widget.
Handles scroll views and drag-to-dismiss interactions natively.
weaknesses: Context provided to the source must not have GlobalKeys in children.
Source widgets are recreated for the shuttle animation.
data.setup_notes: Add the package to pubspec.yaml and import it.

alternatives.name: auto_route
alternatives.why_pick_it: For advanced declarative routing with code generation.

alternatives.name: go_router
alternatives.why_pick_it: For official declarative routing and deep linking support.
